operations.title: Entry 1152 reduces the full integral cusp ambiguity to two parity bits
operations.body: Entry 1152 is verified. Entry 289's pure elliptic rational nilpotent plus Entry 1151's free primitive kernel kills the snake connecting map, but does not force coinvariant splitting. Character equivariance confines the remaining extension to A_{--}=<e6,v_alg>, giving Ext^1_Z(Z/2,Z^2)=(Z/2)^2. Only class (0,0) leaves a visible Z/2; any nonzero class absorbs it into a free rank-two lattice. The next computation needs only the parity of twice one integral elliptic lift in this basis, not the full connection.
